status: source-only proposal; not preregistered, not launchable
hardware: Kaggle TPU v5e-8; archived E463 CPUv3 is CPU correctness evidence only; queued E463 one-device TPU real-data compatibility and E465 all-eight-device full-shape profile plus root budget review are required before fit

shared_scientific_identity.initial_optimizer_state: fresh zeroed AdamW moments for both arms

learning_rate_schedule_parameters.post_last_cosine_extrapolation: preserve PyTorch OneCycleLR behavior; do not clamp

shared_scientific_identity.gradient_clip_order: pmean replica gradients first, then one global norm clip
shared_scientific_identity.fit_batch_order: seeded_group_batches with seed=3, epoch=0; one exact shared order across arms

objective.ema_update_clock: after each 1000-row optimizer update, matching production update path
objective.student_and_ema_state: carry all 20 chunks per sequence; stop gradient at each chunk boundary

distributed_objective.reduction: psum each numerator and denominator across all 8 cores before division
distributed_objective.gradient: scaled local-numerator surrogate, pmean gradients for replicated parameters
distributed_objective.required_proof: loss and parameter-gradient parity versus unsharded reference on unequal and zero-mass shards, including every auxiliary and EMA term

shared_scientific_identity.selection: fixed final epoch-0 state; no validation-based checkpoint selection
shared_scientific_identity.conversion: export to Torch layout only after FP32 CPU forward parity succeeds

root supplies and seals an input manifest matching the E463 fold, parent, parquet, teacher and propensity hashes

root reviews the profile's measured compile/step costs and the worker's full eight-hour timeout including all-VALID prediction exports
bounded CPU comparison passes against production PyTorch OneCycleLR at all indices 0..7460
JAX-free host fold/order/domain/counter and worker helper-call-shape checks pass
bounded scalar dynamic-beta AdamW comparison passes against production torch.optim.AdamW at all 7460 used indices
distributed pooled loss and gradient tests execute successfully on a two-device JAX CPU test
20-chunk recurrent carry and stop-gradient boundary parity test
FP32 and BF16 output and carry parity against Torch CPU references
EMA update and optimizer first-step parity checks
root review of immutable source/input hashes and bounded runtime/quota admission
